question.problem:
Jenny is going to the craft store to buy some supplies. How much would it cost her to buy $\frac{1}{2}$ of a yard of gold ribbon?

| Item | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Gold Ribbon | $$5/\text{yd}$ |
| Silver Ribbon | $$4.5/\text{yd}$ |
question.worked_solution:
The unit price of gold ribbon is $$5/\text{yd}.$ To find the cost of  $\frac{1}{2}$ of a yard of gold ribbon, we multiply: 

$$
\begin{aligned}5\times \frac{1}{2} & =\frac{5}{1}\times \frac{1}{2} \\  & =\frac{5\times 1}{1\times 2} \\  & =\frac{5}{2} \\  & =5÷2 \\  & =2.5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, it would cost Jenny $$2.50$ to buy $\frac{1}{2}$ of a yard of gold ribbon.
